_what: PROMPT-109 s2: the 13 grounded items whose key escaped the cueConfigFor allowance. Each change SHORTENS THE KEY ONLY, keeping what the option asserts. Distractors are untouched, because a distractor may be quoted from a passage and lengthening one risks its own support gate.

items.gate: cue guard -- key 180 vs rival 159, allowed +16
items.why: Drops the redundant 'already' before 'identified'. The issues and requirements are the ones determined under 4.1/4.2; the word added nothing.

options.c: Fix the boundary and its applicability using the internal and external issues and the relevant party requirements identified, and hold the result as documented information.

items.gate: cue guard -- key 137 vs rival 117, allowed +12
items.why: 'arising from the system across its life cycle' becomes 'across the system's life cycle'. Same scope: consequences for people and societies, across the life cycle.

options.d: Broaden the procedure so that potential consequences for people and societies across the system's life cycle are assessed.

items.gate: cue guard -- key 161 vs rival 144, allowed +14
items.why: 'the effect of departing from its rules' becomes 'the effect of not conforming', which is closer to clause 7.3's own wording and shorter.

options.a: People working under the organization's direction are to be aware of the AI policy, how they help the system succeed, and the effect of not conforming.

items.gate: cue guard -- key 138 vs rival 121, allowed +12
items.why: 'a process that checks' becomes 'a process checking' and 'the retailer's own approach' becomes 'the retailer's approach'. Needed a second draft: the first trim left it 2 chars over. The process requirement and both of 'development and use' stay.

options.a: Run a process checking vendor-provided services and products against the retailer's approach to responsible AI development and use.

items.gate: cue guard -- key 161 vs rival 145, allowed +15
items.why: 'in addition to' becomes 'beyond'. The claim is still additive, not substitutive.

options.b: Security questions arising specifically from machine learning approaches merit consideration beyond conventional information and system security matters.

items.gate: cue guard -- key 123 vs rival 108, allowed +11
items.why: Drops 'now'. The stem already asks what is indicated; the obligation and the record both stay.

options.d: Carry out an impact assessment under the organization's defined process, and keep its result as documented information.

items.gate: cue guard -- key 131 vs rival 116, allowed +12
items.why: 'dealing with' becomes 'covering'. The three attributes and the 17021-1 relationship stay.

options.d: It builds on ISO/IEC 17021-1, covering how bodies auditing and certifying an AIMS show competence, consistency and reliability.

items.gate: cue guard -- key 108 vs rival 94, allowed +9
items.why: 'together with their competences' becomes 'with their competences'.

options.b: The people used across build, run, change, maintenance and retirement work, with their competences.

items.gate: cue guard -- key 94 vs rival 80, allowed +8
items.why: 'judge whether it worked' becomes 'judge the effect'. Still the evaluation step, not its outcome.

options.b: Arrange training, mentoring or hiring for the missing expertise, then judge the effect.

items.gate: cue guard -- key 116 vs rival 102, allowed +10
items.why: 'the mix of dedicated specialists' becomes 'the dedicated specialists'; 'combined skills' already carries the mix.

options.b: It lacks the dedicated specialists whose combined skills cover evaluating, building and releasing AI systems.

items.gate: cue guard -- key 116 vs rival 103, allowed +10
items.why: 'apportioned' becomes 'shared'. Same apportionment across the same five party types.

options.a: Life cycle duties are shared among the manufacturer, its partners, vendors, customers and other outside parties

items.gate: cue guard -- key 119 vs rival 107, allowed +11
items.why: 'Controls that partly relate to' becomes 'Controls partly relating to'.

options.c: Controls partly relating to information security can be implemented through the existing ISO/IEC 27001 arrangements.

items.gate: cue guard -- key 111 vs rival 100, allowed +10
items.why: 'requirements that apply to it' becomes 'applicable requirements'.

options.d: Support it in developing, providing or using AI systems responsibly while meeting applicable requirements
